risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative detail, but AMD reported sharply deteriorating results, including a $1.18 billion net loss, declining revenue and gross margin, reduced liquidity, inventory write-downs, and substantial obligations to GlobalFoundries. Management attributes much of the deterioration to macroeconomic and industry conditions and emphasizes restructuring and strategic initiatives, while some large charges are framed as nonrecurring.
